name: Projects_PublicView
title: FERC Projects
description: General location and pertinent details regarding active licensed and exempted hydropower projects. Periodically updated by FRC staff as licenses and exemptions are issued, removed, or capacity changes occur. Layers are updated from the geodatabase feature class data using ArcGIS Pro.
